input_zh: Reading 权威控制固定于 main 提交 b62523606032d485272a9ae879fe9ec4670a12e7。该提交包含 Research Runtime Scheduler V3.0、Worker Control v1.3.0、Generated Reading Prompt v1.0.0（声明 SHA-256 为 9ad93d7f4cd7859fc0b32fa9b3b9e2b836a177c889addcc67d0b4fdc3261d7b5）以及全部 5 个 requiredSources。Worker 已对精确 Generated Prompt 确定性计算 SHA-256 并与声明身份一致；5/5 requiredSources 均从同一控制提交完整读取。精确控制 Head 上的 Validate Research Center 3.0 Run 35047380653 也已成功完成。已核验同日 Reading Wake Receipt 为 research/runtime/wakes/2026/09/2026-09-16/reading-110142.json。Ordered Runtime Reconciliation 于 11:05:23+08:00 打开 Reading，原生 Worker Claim 路径于 11:07:14+08:00 在提交 02b4cb20d461e651d3fea0bd7fd1a9b79455f8d6 中持久记录 Worker Claimed。Reading 只消费同日已完成的 2026-09-16 Research Plan，其中 Q-20260916-01、Q-20260916-02、Q-20260916-03 为三个 Selected P0 Object。
workResult: Completed source-complete Deep Reading for all three same-date Selected objects without performing Research Analysis. Q-20260916-01 read Asclepius across the long-horizon CES simulator, baseline agents, self-evolving operating manual, external skills, isolated subagents, held-out protocol, ablations, failure-mode counters and limitations. The bounded finding is that semantic/diagnostic correctness and sustained operational completion are different evidence dimensions: the strong baseline scores 4.39/5 on diagnosis but 2.94/5 on critical actions, while full Asclepius reports a 22% held-out critical-action gain (p=0.024) with diagnosis preserved. The study is simulation-based, uses LLM graders and one rollout per configuration/batch, and does not establish clinical safety, authorization or exactly-once effects. Q-20260916-02 read AgentQ across the validation-deployment threat model, layer-banded low-rank injection, multi-codebook quantization-equivalence repair, six model scales across Qwen3.5/Hammer2.1, three trigger-action surfaces, NF4/FP4/INT8 results, utility/structured-output ablations, deployment case study, detection surface and limits. The bounded finding is that behavioral evidence attached only to an upstream full-precision checkpoint need not describe the transformed executable artifact: every constructed main-table checkpoint has measured FP16 ASR=0 on the tested attacks while every model/task cell exceeds 0.76 worst-codebook quantized ASR and 12/18 exceed 0.90. The source does not show that ordinary quantization is malicious or that all quantizers are equally vulnerable. Q-20260916-03 read The Router Within/Gavel across hidden-state glance, epsilon-cover skill banks, native verdict, product-of-experts ruling, training/calibration, three public benchmarks, 372 SkillTraj trajectories, live mini-swe-agent integration, ablations, adjudication and cost. The bounded finding is that skill routing can be isolated as a measurable Runtime component rather than permanent metadata preload; the reported Qwen3-32B setup reaches 90.9% correct-skill triggering on Skill-Use and leads the four SkillTraj scenarios, but correct routing is neither downstream task completion nor execution authorization. Reading created exactly three same-date Reading Notes and performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production, Academic or Publication.
workResult_zh: 已对三个同日 Selected Object 完成来源完整 Deep Reading，未执行 Research Analysis。Q-20260916-01 完整深读 Asclepius 的长周期 CES 模拟器、Baseline Agent、自演化 Operating Manual、外部 Skills、隔离 Subagent、Held-out 协议、消融、失败计数与限制。有界结论是：Semantic/Diagnostic Correctness 与 Sustained Operational Completion 是不同证据维度；强 Baseline 的 Diagnosis 为 4.39/5，但 Critical Actions 仅 2.94/5，而 Full Asclepius 在保持 Diagnosis 的同时报告 Held-out Critical-action 提升 22%（p=0.024）。研究仍是模拟实验，依赖 LLM Grader，且每个 Configuration/Batch 只有一次 Rollout，不能证明临床安全、Authorization 或 Exactly-once Effect。Q-20260916-02 完整深读 AgentQ 的 Validation-deployment Threat Model、Layer-banded Low-rank Injection、Multi-codebook Quantization-equivalence Repair、Qwen3.5/Hammer2.1 两家族六个规模、三类 Trigger-action Surface、NF4/FP4/INT8 结果、Utility/Structured-output 消融、部署 Case Study、Detection Surface 与限制。有界结论是：只绑定 Full-precision 上游 Checkpoint 的行为证据不一定描述变换后的可执行 Artifact；主表中每个构造 Checkpoint 在所测攻击上的 FP16 ASR 均为 0，而全部 Model/Task Cell 的 Worst-codebook Quantized ASR 都高于 0.76，18 个中有 12 个高于 0.90。该来源不能推出普通量化本身具有恶意，也不能推出所有 Quantizer 同样脆弱。Q-20260916-03 完整深读 The Router Within/Gavel 的 Hidden-state Glance、Epsilon-cover Skill Bank、Native Verdict、Product-of-experts Ruling、Training/Calibration、三个公开 Benchmark、372 条 SkillTraj、mini-swe-agent 实际接入、消融、Adjudication 与 Cost。有界结论是：Skill Routing 可以作为独立可测 Runtime Component，而不是永久 Metadata Preload；所报告 Qwen3-32B 设置在 Skill-Use 上达到 90.9% Correct-skill Trigger，并在四种 SkillTraj Scenario 中领先，但正确 Routing 既不等于下游 Task Completion，也不等于 Execution Authorization。Reading 共形成 3 份同日 Reading Note，未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production、Academic 或 Publication。
